tools.name: cloud-finops_billing-csv-parse
tools.description: Read brainiac-billing-v1 CSV or JSON charges. Required columns are date, service, cost, and currency. Native cloud-provider exports are rejected. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/billing-csv-parse. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cloud-finops_cost-anomaly-detect
tools.description: Score daily totals with a sample z-score. A day is flagged when the absolute z-score is at least 3 and at least 8 days were supplied. Fewer days are not scored. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/cost-anomaly-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cloud-finops_spend-breakdown
tools.description: Sum supplied charges by service, region, account, or a tag. When groupBy is omitted, charges are grouped by service. Currencies are not converted. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/spend-breakdown. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cloud-finops_idle-resource-detect
tools.description: Mark compute idle only when daysObserved meets the supplied minimum and cpuPercent is below the supplied threshold. Missing CPU is not treated as idle. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/idle-resource-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cloud-finops_unused-storage-detect
tools.description: Mark a volume unused only when the supplied days meet minimumDays and the volume is unattached or usedGb is 0. Attachment alone is not usage. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/unused-storage-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cloud-finops_compute-cost-compare
tools.description: Multiply each supplied hourly price by the supplied hours. Options in different currencies are not converted, and no provider list price is added. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/compute-cost-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cloud-finops_monthly-cost-forecast
tools.description: Fit a line through at least three supplied monthly totals, or multiply the average daily cost by the length of the next month when at least 14 days are supplied. Less history is not forecast. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/monthly-cost-forecast. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment t

tools.name: cloud-finops_budget-variance-analyze
tools.description: Subtract the supplied budget from the supplied charges inside the period. Missing days stay uncovered and are not filled with zero from another currency. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/budget-variance-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cloud-finops_cost-allocation
tools.description: Group supplied charges by one tag key. Charges without that tag remain unallocated. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/cloud-finops/cost-allocation. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: cloud-finops_cost-optimization-report
tools.description: Combine the supplied billing, usage, price, and budget checks. Recommendations repeat the evidence and the assumption. No account is connected and no resource is changed. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "cloud-finops" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cloud-finops_billing-csv-parse, cloud-finops_compute-cost-compare · Public sink: cloud-finops_billing-csv-parse, cloud-finops_cost-anomaly-detect, cloud-finops_spend-breakdown, cloud-finops_idle-resource-detect, cloud-finops_unused-storage-detect, cloud-finops_compute-cost-compare, cloud-finops_monthly-cost-forecast, cloud-finops_budget-variance-analyze, cloud-finops_cost-allocation, cloud-finops_cost-optimization-report · Destructive: cloud-finops_billing-csv-parse, cloud-finops_cost-anomaly-detect, cloud-finops_spend-breakdown, cloud-finops_idle-resource-detect, cloud-finops_unused-storage-detect, cloud-finops_compute-cost-compare, cloud-finops_monthly-cost-forecast, cloud-finops_budget-variance-analyze, cloud-finops_cost-allocation, cloud-finops_cost-optimization-report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
